facts.fact: The State Department for ICT and the Digital Economy's draft AI policy (July 2026, published on ict.go.ke) lists the Kenya National Digital Masterplan (2022-2032) as the strategic direction for digital transformation, with priorities in digital infrastructure, data ecosystems, innovation and digital skills.

The State Department for ICT and the Digital Economy's draft AI policy (July 2026, published on ict.go.ke) lists the Kenya National Digital Masterplan (2022-2032) as the strategic direction for digital transformation, with priorities in digital infrastructure, data ecosystems, innovation and digital skills.

The draft AI policy says there are national targets to train 20 million citizens under the Kenya AI Strategy (2025-2030) and the Digital Master Plan (2022-2032); no cost or date for the target is given.
